name: 20 oz. Wide Mouth Stainless Steel Vacuum Bottle
description: This stainless steel bottle will have recipients gulping down your brand messaging! Ideal for exercising or hydrating at work, this 20 oz. water bottle is made of stainless steel and comes in an assortment of fashionable colors. Features include a wide mouth opening, a durable stainless steel carry handle, spill-proof bamboo top twist cap and double wall vacuum insulation that's designed to keep beverages hot or cold for hours. Add a company name or logo using one of our multiple imprint options. Put your logo right in their hands with every sip! Other capacity are also available.
